title: src/glovebox
subtitle: The gate: operator-issued agent tokens, five read tools (accounts, list, count, group, topic IDs), fixture mail source, SQLite store and the output validator

evidence.note: Only the acceptance tests' MCP client connects today; inferred as the agent.

Outermost middleware; looks the bearer token up in the database on every request, so a revoked token stops at once, and records the token's id, which page cursors and the token's accounts are bound to.
Low-level Server with only tools/list and tools/call handlers: no resources, prompts or operator commands. A token is shown only the tools its operations name.

Validates the call's inputs, checks the cursor, fetches only the token's accounts, classifies the items that need it (see classifier.json), then answers from the store; the sort orders, filters and the 1000+ cap live in store.py.
With no command, serves; account and token commands are the operator's local command line (cli.py), which opens the database file directly.
The only code that sees raw upstream structure; reads an item's subject and body only for the classifier, never to store or serve. open_source checks the account's credentials file mode first.

Permitted fields, semantic fields, keyed-digest handle and content mappings and sync state; no raw text. Mail outside the 30-day window is not stored. Accounts and token digests live in the same file (access.py).
Checks the whole result; a failure becomes the fixed response_invalid error.
add_middleware makes the token check the outermost layer of the app.
